research_scope: development-only mechanism audit on the frozen AgentDojo-v2 archive
research_questions: Does the semantic event model beat a legal-candidate hierarchical Markov baseline when every held-out task receives equal weight?

Does observed event identity and order improve the joint utility/security distribution beyond static semantics, sequence length, a shuffled event multiset, random legal events, and a Markov-generated prefix?
Do the attack-semantic fields add held-out-task information beyond domain, clean prior, and event history?

claim_boundary.reason: validation and test each contain only four independent tasks; the one-sided all-positive sign-test floor is 0.0625

forbidden_as_model_input: future true candidate set in free rollout

training_objective.event_losses: unbiased equal-task mean using inverse per-task event count
training_objective.joint_outcome_losses: unbiased equal-task mean using inverse per-task joint-support weight
training_objective.checkpoint_selection: validation task-macro next_skill_nll + 0.25 * validation task-macro dynamic_joint_count_nll

learned_variants.length_semantic: attack semantics, domain, clean prior, and sequence position/length; every attended event identity is replaced with BOS
learned_variants.event_no_attack_semantics: observed event history, domain, and clean prior; every attack-semantic field is replaced with its training UNK token

prefix_value_controls_on_full_model.static_semantic: static joint head with no event residual
prefix_value_controls_on_full_model.shuffled: deterministic shuffle preserving prefix length and event multiset
prefix_value_controls_on_full_model.length_only: BOS at every observed event position
prefix_value_controls_on_full_model.random_length_matched: deterministic samples from the initial legal candidate set
prefix_value_controls_on_full_model.markov_length_matched: candidate-constrained hierarchical Markov generation at the observed length
prefix_value_controls_on_full_model.semantic_markov_length_matched: field-factorized semantic candidate Markov generation at the observed length

counterbaselines.candidate_uniform: uniform probability over the legal current-state candidates
counterbaselines.candidate_hierarchical_markov: domain and previous-event hierarchical Markov restricted to legal candidates
counterbaselines.candidate_factorized_semantic_markov: training-only field-factorized attack semantics plus domain and previous event, restricted to legal candidates

stage_b_component_coverage.static_semantic: length_semantic next-skill condition plus static_semantic joint head
stage_b_component_coverage.tool_name_only_prefix: current event identity is normalized selected skill/tool name
stage_b_component_coverage.argument_slots: available only as an auxiliary prediction target; no causal argument-input ablation is claimed
stage_b_component_coverage.state_delta: not run because canonical_state_delta is unavailable in the frozen v2 archive
stage_b_component_coverage.outcome_head: static semantic head versus dynamic prefix-residual head
stage_b_component_coverage.random_initialization_ensemble: three frozen seeds with sequence, outcome-TV, and trajectory-ranking stability diagnostics

decision_rule.full_mechanism_signal: all predictive, component, prefix-content, prefix-order, stability, and per-task-direction gates pass
decision_rule.content_without_order_signal: predictive and prefix-content gates pass but observed does not beat shuffled prefix
decision_rule.architecture_without_mechanism_identific: full model beats Markov but one or more component/negative-control gates fail
decision_rule.shortcut_not_ruled_out: full model does not retain task-macro predictive advantage over Markov
decision_rule.clean_gate_override: all outcomes remain CLEAN_GATE_BLOCKED; this experiment cannot authorize attack-data generation, H2 attack planning, selective deployment, or Dreamer training
